cases.behavior: Repeating the same actual compose request leaves one document, one operation, and one physical command.
An unknown partial receipt stays unconfirmed, exposes no delivery details, and does not trigger a resend.
A seeded forwarded body with multibyte UTF-8 survives actual compose, receipt, and detail read byte-for-byte beyond a preview-sized body.
A pending restore state refuses the actual read; clearing the same pending state permits the same document to read.

In the ordinary unprofiled scope, 27 owner-confirmed delivered letters finish paging on an empty final page; the older malformed row remains unknown transfer risk, while a synthetic 500-gold manual letter beyond page one resumes after owner-observed presence into one operation and one command.
Closed, companion-owned, managed-child, linked-operation, orphan-operation, dispatch-anchor, partial/unknown, and out-of-scope requests refuse resume without a second transfer.
Concurrent explicit resume attempts for one queued manual request serialize under the owner writer fence and create at most one operation and delivery command.

A newer insert and a late backdated manual insert inside the scanned keyset range each make continuation fail with stale_revision before another candidate scan and without owner writes; a restore/profile discovery fence failure also errors instead of returning empty success.

Caller-freshness proof: a fresh actual API child enters the pinned owner cold bootstrap with the canonical helper loaded from its captured hash and generation 7. The real owner native-request hook creates a current anchored request activity with no legacy managed-presence payload or nearby-actor report; The Narrator resumes the same saved 500-gold document and repeat leaves one document, one operation, and one command. This is database evidence, not game delivery.

Caller-freshness proof: two fresh actual API children race resume for the same saved 500-gold document after the real owner native-request hook creates a current anchored activity with legacy managed presence absent and no nearby actor report; The Narrator yields at most one operation and one command.

On the same saved 500-gold activity-only document, a real passive native observation, interaction Off, a generation change after helper Begin, and a genuinely aged 46-second anchored activity each require the actual resume API to project queued/executor_unavailable with zero operation and command. Pending and changed-restore variants require stale_context before any write and record whether restore preflight stopped before owner helper bootstrap. The expiry branch preserves and rechecks the original event anchor without editing received_at.
